title: Dugoff Wheel 2DOF
text: Dugoff Wheel 2DOF wheel with disc, drum, or mapped brake, 11 inputs, 8 outputs, {Brake pad mean radius, Rm} sets Radius; {Tire type} selects type User, {Model slip type}, {Brake type}, {Rolling Resistance} sets the rolling resistance torque, {Vertical Motion} sets the vertical motion model, {Longitudinal stiffness, Ckappa} sets the longitudinal stiffness 1e7, {Lateral stiffness per slip angle, Calpha} sets the lateral stiffness 4.5e4, {Camber stiffness, Cgamma} sets the camber stiffness 1e3, {Maximum friction scaling coefficient, mu0}, {Friction reduction factor, As}, {Longitudinal relaxation length, Lrelx}, {Lateral relaxation length, Lrely}, {Longitudinal squared slip correction factor, gx1}, {Longitudinal squared slip friction correction factor, gx2}, {Longitudinal linear slip correction factor, gx3}, {Longitudinal linear slip friction correction factor, gx4}, {Longitudinal offset correction factor, gx5}, {Lateral maximum friction correction factor, gy1}, {Lateral offset correction factor, gy2}, {Velocity independent force coefficient, aMy} sets the velocity-independent force coefficient, {Linear velocity force component, bMy} sets the linear velocity force, {Quadratic velocity force component, cMy} sets the quadratic velocity force, {Tire pressure exponent, alphaMy}, {Normal force exponent, betaMy}, {Parasitic losses force, Fpl} sets the parasitic force loss, {Rolling resistance constant, Cr} sets the rolling resistance constant 1e-3, {Thermal correction factor, Kt}, {Measured temperature, Tmeas} sets the temperature during testing, {Ambient temperature, Tamb} sets the temperature in application environment, {Input ambient temperature} sets the option to input ambient temperature, {Rolling resistance torque coefficient, QSY1} sets the torque coefficient, {Longitudinal force rolling resistance coefficient, QSY2} sets the force resistance coefficient, {Linear rotational speed rolling resistance coefficient, QSY3} sets the linear speed coefficient, {Quartic rotational speed rolling resistance coefficient, QSY4} sets the quartic speed coefficient 8.5e-05, {Camber squared rolling resistance torque, QSY5} sets the camber resistance torque, {Load based camber squared rolling resistance torque, QSY6} sets the load resistance torque, {Normal load rolling resistance coefficient, QSY8} sets the normal resistance coefficient, {Pressure load rolling resistance coefficient, QSY8} sets the pressure resistance coefficient, {Rolling resistance scaling factor, lam_My} sets the scaling factor, {Spin axis velocity breakpoints, VxMy} sets the spin axis velocity, {Normal force breakpoints, FzMy} sets the normal force breakpoints, {Rolling resistance torque map, MyMap} sets the rolling resistance torque, {Tire nominal section width, WIDTH} sets the tire nominal section, {Linear yaw rate resistance, bMz}, {Static friction coefficient, mu_static}, {Kinetic friction coefficient, mu_kinetic}, {Disc brake actuator bore, disc_abore} sets the bore distance, {Number of brake pads, num_pads}, {Drum brake actuator bore, drum_abore} sets the bore distance, {Shoe pin to drum center distance, drum_a}, {Shoe pin center to force application point distance, drum_c}, {Drum internal radius, drum_r}, {Shoe pin to pad start angle, drum_theta1}, {Shoe pin to pad end angle, drum_theta2}, {Brake actuator pressure breakpoints, brake_p_bpt} sets the brake actuator pressure, {Wheel speed breakpoints, brake_n_bpt} sets the wheel speed breakpoints vector, {Brake torque map, f_brake_t} sets the lookup table for brake, {Rotational damping, br} sets the rotational damping scalar, {Tire rotational inertia (rolling axis), IYY} sets the tire rotational inertia scalar, {Initial wheel rotational velocity, omegao} sets the initial wheel rotational, {Tire unloaded radius, UNLOADED_RADIUS}, {Tire mass, MASS}, {Initial tire displacement, zo}, {Initial wheel vertical velocity (wheel fixed frame), zdoto}, {Gravitational acceleration, GRAVITY}, {Vertical deflection breakpoints, zFz} sets the vertical deflection breakpoints, {Pressure breakpoints, pFz} sets the pressure breakpoints, {Force due to deflection, Fzz} sets the force due to deflection {Vertical velocity breakpoints, zdotFz} sets the vertical velocity breakpoints, {Force due to velocity, Fzzdot} sets the force due to velocity, {Maximum normal force, FZMAX}, {Minimum normal force, FZMIN}, {Maximum pressure, PRESMAX}, {Minimum pressure, PRESMIN}, {Max allowable slip ratio (absolute), KPUMAX}, {Minimum allowable slip ratio (absolute), KPUMIN}, {Max allowable slip angle (absolute), ALPMAX}, {Minimum allowable slip angle (absolute), ALPMIN}, {Maximum allowable camber angle, CAMMAX}, {Minimum allowable camber angle, CAMMIN}, {Minimum ambient temperature, TMIN}, {Maximum ambient temperature, TMAX}, {Install Extended Tire Features} sets the option to install Extended Tire Features for Vehicle Dynamics Blockset™ support package and {Plot steady state force, moment response} sets the option to plot steady-state force and moment tire responses. Values come from the instance.
